defects.claim: `orgName`, `lastShippedAt` and `poolPercentUsed` are read from the dashboard payload, but nothing in the checkout ever sends them on that payload. As a result the header in production always shows "— / Last shipped —" and never shows Pool
defects.evidence: Evidence: the mock producer `src/lib/api/mockAdapter.ts:1064-1069` returns only `window`, `stats`, `activity` and `projects`. The fixture `src/lib/api/__tests__/fixtures/dashboard.json:3` has only `"stats": { "shipped": 8, "needsYou": 2 }`. Grep finds these keys nowhere outside the diff and its test. The pool value actually lives on the allowance endpoint (`httpAdapter.ts:342 percent_used?: number`, `httpAdapter.ts:423 wire.percent_used ??`), and the org name lives in the auth store (`AppHeader.vue:151 const orgName = computed(() => auth.org?.name ?? '')`). The adapter and mock were not changed together, which breaks the CLAUDE.md lockstep rule.

defects.claim: `stats.timeToPrMinutes` is read but nothing produces it, so Time to PR is always '—'
defects.evidence: Evidence: `mockAdapter.ts:1066 stats: { shipped: ..., needsYou: cards.filter((c) => c.needsYou).length }` has no such key, and the fixture `dashboard.json:3` doesn't either.

defects.claim: The new GH-249 tests replace `mockAdapter.getDashboard` with a hand-built `Dashboard` that already contains the new fields. They never exercise `toDashboard` (httpAdapter.ts:1071), so they prove nothing about the wire contract. No httpAdapter.spec case covers the new keys; `httpAdapter.spec.ts:2036` still asserts only `{ shipped: 8, needsYou: 2 }`.

The requirement says "no '$' or 'tokens' on a platform-key tenant", but the test never sets up a platform-key tenant. It passes a payload with `poolPercentUsed: 42` and no session or platform-key state, so the platform-key case is never tested.

The "/100" denominator is a hard-coded literal, not taken from any payload field. That conflicts with CLAUDE.md rule 3: "never fabricate data". Delivered also uses the default slot, not the `numerator`/`denominator` props (`StatCard.vue:62-64`), so it loses the green numerator the primitive gives.
The `lane=needs-you` query has no consumer. Grep for `query|useRoute` in `src/views/BoardView.vue` finds nothing, so the link lands on the unfiltered board.
There is no "## Evidence" block, so no build, test or lint output is pasted.

The org name and pool percent read fields that don't exist, while real producers are already in the repo. The org name exists as `const orgName = computed(() => auth.org?.name ?? '')` (`AppHeader.vue:151`). `percent_used` exists on the allowance wire, read by `getAllowance` (`httpAdapter.ts:422` `percentUsed:` / `:423` `wire.percent_used ??`), which PR #250 added for this parent. The requirements "org name on the left" and "Pool <percent_used>%" are therefore never met at runtime.

The Review-needed link goes to `/board?lane=needs-you`, but BoardView never reads it: a Grep for `route\.query|useRoute\(` in `src/views/BoardView.vue` finds nothing. The query does nothing on arrival.

Delivered uses the default slot instead of StatCard's `numerator`/`denominator` variant. The numerator therefore misses the `text-ds-green` that the design's N/100 split specifies (`StatCard.vue:63`).
Mobile Cost tile gets a new `costTile.note` line. This is mobile behaviour outside the desktop stat-row slice. Mobile "Median → PR" (`:348`) still hardcodes `—` and ignores `timeToPr`.

not_verified: The backend (pilot-console C16 `dashboardapi` DTO) is not in this checkout, so I couldn't confirm whether it will ever emit `orgName`, `lastShippedAt`, `poolPercentUsed` or `timeToPrMinutes`.
Whether the console C16 handler has added or plans to add these camelCase fields: the counterpart `internal/dashboardapi/dto.go` is in a sibling repo and can't be read here.

notes:
[pass A (hunk)]
- Four StatCards in order: met. `DashboardView.vue:305-316` renders Delivered, Review needed, Time to PR, Projects. A different order would fail the test's `toEqual` on `[data-stat-label]` (spec:464), and it doesn't.
- Values from the payload, '—' when missing: met in the view (`DashboardView.vue:83 dash = (v) => (v === undefined ? '—' : String(v))`), but in practice it is always '—' for the new fields (see blocking defects 1 and 2).
- Review needed links to `/board?lane=needs-you`: met. `DashboardView.vue:308 :to="{ path: '/board', query: { lane: 'needs-you' } }"`. A named route without the query would fail the href test, and this uses a path plus query. BoardView ignores the query (minor).
- Header row with org name, Last shipped and Pool %: done in the template (`DashboardView.vue:297-301`), and Pool is hidden when `poolPercent === undefined`. It is not met in practice because the source fields have no producer.
- Honest-degrade kept: met. Time to PR shows `DEGRADED_METRIC_NOTE` when `!timeToPr` (`DashboardView.vue:313`), and the Cost note moves to the mobile glance (`DashboardView.vue:353`). This would only fail if `timeToPrMinutes` came through as 0 (that gives "~0", which is truthy, so it is safe).
- Docblock cites `design/dashboard-v4.html` + `dashboard-v4-spec.md` and records the trims: met at `DashboardView.vue:48-56`.
- Tests: label order, the /100 split and the link target are covered. The platform-key case is not set up (blocking defect 4).
- Scope fence: no sibling GH-240 work was found in the diff.

Four labels in order: met at src/views/DashboardView.vue:304-316 (Delivered, Review needed, Time to PR, Projects), checked by spec `[data-stat-label]` toEqual. Order doesn't depend on data, so no input can reorder it.
Missing field → '—': rendering is met at DashboardView.vue:83 `dash` and :316 `dashboard ? projects.length : '—'`. Because the fields have no producer, they are always '—' (see blocking defects).
Review needed is a RouterLink to /board?lane=needs-you: met at DashboardView.vue:307, checked by the href test. The target view ignores `lane`.
Header row with org name and Last shipped/Pool, Pool hidden when absent: the template is met at DashboardView.vue:297-301 (`v-if="poolPercent !== undefined"`). The data source is wrong (blocking).
